title: File:Amazon River ESA17276564.tiff
desc: The Copernicus Sentinel-2A satellite takes us over northern Brazil on 22 August 2017, where the Amazon River meets the Atlantic Ocean.Click on the box in the lower-right corner to view this image at its full 10 m resolution directly in your browser.The sediment-laden water appears brown as it flows

title: File:Global Forest Change tree-cover loss year in the Brazilian Amazon, 2001-2024.png
desc: Map of annual tree-cover loss year in the Global Forest Change dataset for the Brazilian Amazon. Pixels with tree cover of at least 30% in 2000 and no mapped loss through 2024 are shown in dark green; pixels with mapped tree-cover loss are coloured by the first detected loss year from 2001 to 2024;
